title: Single Line IF...ELSE Statement
code:
#Single Line IF...ELSE Condition

number = 100
print("Number less than 100") if (number <= 100) else print("Number Greater than 100")

lines.explanation: In python, IF...ELSE Condition can be written in a single line statement for simplicity. This is called as the Pythonic way of programming
Integer 100 is asigned to the variable 'number'

lines.code: print("Number less than 100") if (number <= 100) else print("Number Greater than 100")
lines.explanation: This statement is read and understood in the following way: Print 'Number less than 100' if number is less than or equal to 100 or else print 'Number Greater than 100'.
